supersedes_diagnostic: S21 (docs/research/s21_ob_oi_limit_entry) tried a resting limit at the order block's fixed 50% midpoint, registered only after the zone had already been touched and started reclaiming. That demanded an unrealistic additional retracement and collapsed fill count from S20's 137 to 17, with the few fills that did happen performing badly (PF 0.10) — likely a lower-quality subset (deeper adverse excursion before reversing). This protocol corrects ONLY the limit-pricing rule: instead of the zone's fixed midpoint, the resting limit asks for a small, ATR-scaled concession (default 0.25x ATR) relative to the price already observed at the touch bar, clamped to never ask for a price outside the zone. Entry confirmation (regime + structure + OBV + OI), stop placement and exit management (S20's patient breakeven/trailing) are otherwise unchanged from S20/S21.

hypotheses.regime: identical to S16-S21: 4h EMA200 trend+slope confirmed by 1h ADX(14) >= 20
hypotheses.structure: identical order-block detection to S17-S21 (displacement>=1.5xATR, volume>=1.2x avg, first-touch trigger, zone active up to 32 bars, consumed on first touch)
hypotheses.flow: OBV must still be on the trend side of its own EMA(9) at the touch bar
hypotheses.positioning: open interest change over the prior 8 bars must be non-negative/non-positive in the trade direction (identical to S18/S20/S21)
hypotheses.entry: resting LIMIT order at close(touch bar) minus/plus 0.25x ATR (clamped to the zone extremes), TTL 45 minutes (3 bars); may go unfilled if price never reaches even this modest concession in time
hypotheses.risk: stop = zone boundary opposite the trend direction, minus/plus 0.15 ATR buffer, measured from the concession limit price; actual-fill stop width clamped 0.50-3.00 ATR
hypotheses.exit: identical to S20 H1: breakeven+chandelier trailing activated at +1.5R, trail at best-price minus 2.5x ATR (ATR frozen at entry); 8.0R hard cap; 240 minute time stop

hypotheses.session_filter: additionally restricted to the London/NY killzones already used by S13 and S21 H2 (l1_filter.bollinger_regime_scalp._in_trading_window)

single_variable_isolated: Only the limit-pricing rule changes versus S21 H1/H2 (ATR concession instead of zone midpoint). Entry signal generation, regime, structure, flow, OI confirmation, stop placement, exit management and position sizing are otherwise byte-for-byte identical to S20/S21.

symbols.note: Reuses the exact same cached klines/funding/metrics archives already downloaded for S18/S20/S21 — no new data source.

promotion_gates.development_to_validation: PF >1.05, net PnL >0, at least 40 fills
promotion_gates.validation_to_retrospective_evaluation: base PF >1.10, stress PF >=1.00, at least 20 base fills, at least 2/3 symbols net positive, no symbol >60% gross profit
promotion_gates.paper_to_live: at least 200 prospective candidates across three full frozen months, PF >=1.25 base and >=1.10 stress, expectancy >=0.10R, 95% session-block bootstrap lower bound >0, max DD <=4%

execution.one_global_position: single global minute event loop with one shared cash balance, pending order and open position across the correlated ETH/SOL/BNB cluster
execution.ambiguous_bar: stop first; no favorable exit on limit fill minute

selection: Exactly H1 and H2. No parameter grid over the concession size (fixed at 0.25x ATR, a modest, pre-declared fraction, not tuned against this data) or limit TTL. A failing gate stops that route; choose no least-bad winner.
stress_semantics: Stress and severe are deployability replays: higher costs and limit penetration are known before entry, so the reward/cost filter is reapplied and the fill cohort may shrink.
known_limitations: A resting limit may still not fill if price never returns even to this modest concession within the TTL.
Same order-block, OI, ATR-freeze and no-order-book-reconstruction simplifications as S18/S20/S21.
This is a retrospective diagnostic; not a live paper-forward result.
